step1_figure.description: Figure 25.19 shows the simulation schematic of the fully-differential bottom-plate sample-and-hold circuit with 1 pF sampling and load capacitors, NMOS switches, and an ideal op-amp model referenced to VCM = 500 mV.

common_mode_voltage.description: Common-mode reference voltage around which the differential signals swing

equation.explanation: Defines the ideal common-mode voltage level to maximize differential output dynamic range between ground and VDD.
equation.assumptions: Symmetric swing between VDD and ground; in the simulation netlist VCM is set to 500 mV.

sky130_expected.calculation: For the provided testbench, VDD is normalized to 1.0 V with VCM = 500 mV (for 1.8 V full supply, VDD/2 = 0.9 V). Here VCM is directly fixed by DC source VCM = 0.5 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The reference voltage source sets VCM to 500 mV, and op-amp inputs/outputs are balanced around this value.

differential_input_offset.description: Differential input error voltage across the op-amp virtual short during tracking mode

equation.explanation: Due to high open-loop gain (A_OL = 1e6) and negative feedback during phi1/phi3, the differential voltage between the non-inverting and inverting inputs is virtually zero.
equation.assumptions: Op-amp operates in linear region with high loop gain.

sky130_expected.calculation: With A_OL = 1e6 and output differential voltage < 200 mV, v_diff_in = v_out / A_OL = 200 mV / 1e6 = 0.2 uV, virtually 0 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: With ideal VCVS gain of 10^6, differential offset between vp and vm is negligible (< 1 mV).

differential_output_amplitude.description: Peak differential output voltage of the sample-and-hold tracking the differential input signal

equation.formula: v_out,diff(t) = v_outp(t) - v_outm(t) approx v_inp - v_inm
equation.explanation: In hold mode, the differential output holds the sampled input differential voltage with unity gain.
equation.assumptions: Equal sampling capacitors (1 pF) and zero differential charge injection.

sky130_expected.calculation: Vinp_pk = 100 mV, Vinm_pk = -100 mV => Vin_diff_pk = 200 mV. Ideal held differential peak is 200 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sampling unity follower achieves nominal 200 mV peak differential output with slight attenuation due to switch resistance and finite hold charge.

sample_and_hold_gain.description: Differential voltage gain from input to held output

equation.formula: A_v = v_out,diff / v_in,diff = C_H / (C_H + C_p_top) approx 1.0
equation.explanation: Because bottom plate sampling connects the top plate to high-impedance virtual ground and parasitic capacitance on poly2 is minimized, gain is near unity.
equation.assumptions: Infinite op-amp open-loop gain and parasitic top-plate capacitance much less than CH.

sky130_expected.calculation: A_v = 1 pF / (1 pF + C_p) approx 0.99 V/V given C_p from NMOS junctions ~ 10 fF.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Small parasitic junction capacitance causes < 2% gain error.

differential_hold_pedestal.description: Differential offset error introduced by clock feedthrough and charge injection

source.reference: Page 839 discussion on t1, t2, V_OFF

equation.explanation: Bottom plate sampling turns off phi1 first at constant VCM, making charge injection common-mode and ideally canceled differentially.
equation.assumptions: Matched NMOS switches xm3 and xm4 turning off simultaneously.

sky130_expected.calculation: Common-mode offset V_OFF1 = q_inj / CH approx (W*L*Cox*(Vdd - Vth - Vcm))/CH = (10u*1u*1.7e-15*0.88)/1pF = 15 mV. Differential mismatch is typically < 5% of common mode: ~0.75 mV.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Differential architecture and early switch turn-off suppresses charge injection pedestal to under 10 mV.

step3_testbench.description: Transient testbench for the fully-differential sample-and-hold circuit verifying common-mode level, differential input tracking, output amplitude, differential gain, and offset.
step3_testbench.spice:
* Fully-Differential Sample-and-Hold Simulation Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

* Parameter definitions for switches (10u/1u as in Fig 25.19)
.param W_xm1=10u L_xm1=1u
.param W_xm2=10u L_xm2=1u
.param W_xm3=10u L_xm3=1u
.param W_xm4=10u L_xm4=1u
.param W_xm5=10u L_xm5=1u
.param W_xm6=10u L_xm6=1u
.param W_xm7=10u L_xm7=1u
.param W_xm8=10u L_xm8=1u

* Input differential sinusoidal sources at 5 MHz referenced to 500 mV VCM
V1 Vinm 0 SINE(500m -100m 5MEG)
V2 Vinp 0 SINE(500m 100m 5MEG)

* Ideal differential op-amp model (Fig 25.18)
E1 vop N002 vp vm 1e6
E2 N002 vom vp vm 1e6
VCM N002 0 500mV

* Sampling and hold capacitors (1 pF)
C1 vm N001 1e-12
C2 vp N003 1e-12
C3 voutp 0 1e-12
C4 voutm 0 1e-12

* Switches (Fig 25.19)
xm1 N001 phi2 vinp 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm1} l={L_xm1}
xm2 N003 phi2 vinm 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm2} l={L_xm2}
xm3 vop phi1 vm 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm3} l={L_xm3}
xm4 vom phi1 vp 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm4} l={L_xm4}
xm5 vop phi3 N001 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm5} l={L_xm5}
xm6 N003 phi3 vom 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm6} l={L_xm6}
xm7 voutp phi3 vop 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm7} l={L_xm7}
xm8 vom phi3 voutm 0 sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 w={W_xm8} l={L_xm8}

* Non-overlapping Clock Generator: Period T = 20 ns (50 MHz)
* phi1: early turn-off switch (turns off at t1 = 7.5 ns)
Vphi1 phi1 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.5n 0.2n 0.2n 7.0n 20n)
* phi2: input sampling switch (turns off at t2 = 8.5 ns)
Vphi2 phi2 0 PULSE(0 1.8 0.5n 0.2n 0.2n 8.0n 20n)
* phi3: hold mode switch (turns on at t3 = 10.5 ns, off at 18.5 ns)
Vphi3 phi3 0 PULSE(0 1.8 10.5n 0.2n 0.2n 8.0n 20n)

.control
tran 0.05n 200n

* Calculate differential signals
let vdiff_in = v(vinp) - v(vinm)
let vdiff_out = v(voutp) - v(voutm)
let vcm_out = 0.5 * (v(voutp) + v(voutm))
let vdiff_op_in = v(vp) - v(vm)

* Measure common-mode voltage during hold phase
meas tran meas_vcm_out avg vcm_out from=100n to=200n

* Measure op-amp input virtual short error
meas tran max_vdiff_op_in max abs(vdiff_op_in) from=100n to=200n

* Measure peak input and output differential voltages
meas tran vdiff_in_max max vdiff_in from=100n to=200n
meas tran vdiff_out_max max vdiff_out from=100n to=200n

* Calculate gain
let diff_gain = vdiff_out_max / vdiff_in_max
print meas_vcm_out max_vdiff_op_in vdiff_in_max vdiff_out_max diff_gain

quit
.endc
.end
